executive_summary: Supervised machine learning, generalization theory, and rigorous evaluation methodology are discussed in this course. High capacity models with too many degrees of freedom exhibit low training error but high variance, resulting in severe overfitting. Precision measures the proportion of positive predictive predictions that are truly positive, controlling false positive alert fatigue, and more. The F1 score computes the harmonic mean of precision and recall, penalizing extreme imbalances between the two metrics.
